subject: Outstanding balance reconciliation & VAT allocation for Medivio
messages:
From: Luca Bruni <luca.bruni@medivio.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@medivio.com
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Question on INV-2027-439 and VAT allocation

Hi Monica,

Apologies for the delay — we're working through a VAT treatment issue on invoice INV-2027-439 (attached). Our tax team says Medivio is the reverse-charge entity for this period and that the VAT amount should not be paid to Redwood. That puts the invoice balance in dispute: we need confirmation of how Redwood will reflect the VAT, and whether we can split the total so the net subscription amount is paid while VAT is held pending confirmation.

We do want to keep the service active; however procurement has placed a temporary payment hold until we reconcile. Can you advise next steps and whether Redwood will accept a partial payment (net amount) while VAT is clarified?

Thanks,
Luca Bruni
CFO, Medivio
Luca.Bruni@medivio.com

Attachment: INV-2027-439.pdf
From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: Luca Bruni <luca.bruni@medivio.com>
Cc: procurement@medivio.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2027 11:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Question on INV-2027-439 and VAT allocation

Hi Luca — thanks for flagging and for the invoice. I chatted with Finance this morning (see below). Short answer: we can accept a partial payment for the net subscription amount to avoid service interruption, with the VAT held in a suspense account until mutual confirmation. To proceed I need: 1) a brief VAT position note from your tax/contact (a one-paragraph PDF will do), and 2) confirmation from procurement on timing for the remaining VAT payment.

Proposed pathway:
- Medivio pays the net amount (EUR 38,400) by 10 Dec to avoid credit hold.
- Redwood will place VAT (EUR 7,680) in a suspense ledger and reserve the right to reopen reconciliation once your tax position is provided.
- We draft a short partial-payment agreement & release (DocuSign) for signatures — I can send the DocuSign today.

If that works, I'll loop in Finance and Legal to finalize wording. We can also schedule a 30-min call with your tax lead to close the treatment.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: partial-payment-agreement.docx (draft will be prepared after internal review)
From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 3 Dec 2027 08:22:00 +0000
Subject: Medivio — VAT reverse-charge; request for approval of partial-payment pathway

Team — forwarding the thread with Medivio (CFO Luca Bruni). They have placed a hold because their tax team believes reverse-charge applies for the period covering INV-2027-439 (EUR 46,080 total). Procurement asked if we can accept net-only payment to keep services online.

Outline:
- Invoice: INV-2027-439, due 2027-11-30, outstanding EUR 46,080 (net EUR 38,400 + VAT EUR 7,680)
- External ask: accept net payment now; hold VAT in suspense until Medivio shares their VAT position note
- Risk areas: potential short-term cash impact and accounting/tax treatment if Medivio later disputes VAT liability; possible need to reissue credit note or raise VAT-only invoice

Requesting approvals: 
1) Finance (Evelyn) — is it acceptable to post VAT to a suspense ledger and accept net payment while we retain right to recover VAT later?
2) Legal (Markus) — please review a short DocuSign partial-payment agreement (1 page) that preserves Redwood's right to collect VAT later and limits refund/credit exposure.
3) Sales (Ben) — recommend approval to avoid service disruption for a strategic mid-market customer; advise if commercial concessions are expected.

I've attached the invoice they sent and their VAT cert. I'll prepare a short DocuSign once I have sign-off.

Thanks,
Monica

Attachments: INV-2027-439.pdf, VAT_certificate_medivio.pdf
From: evelyn_hart@redwood.com
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 4 Dec 2027 10:15:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Medivio — VAT reverse-charge; request for approval of partial-payment pathway

Monica — Finance is OK with the proposed operational approach provided: (a) the partial-payment agreement explicitly states the VAT amount will be placed in a Redwood suspense ledger and is not considered waived, (b) Medivio provides a dated VAT position note signed by a tax lead within 14 days, and (c) we include a clause that if VAT is later determined payable by Medivio, Redwood may issue a VAT-only invoice or request payment within 30 days of determination.

Please loop in Collections to tag the invoice accordingly and coordinate GL entries. We'll need accounting language in the DocuSign so auditors are satisfied. Mark, can Legal draft a one-paragraph protective clause?

Evelyn Hart
VP, Finance & Operations
Redwood Inference

From: monica_patel@redwood.com

Hi Luca / Anita,

Thanks — Finance and Legal have reviewed and we can proceed on the pathway below. I've attached the proposed one-page partial-payment agreement for quick review. Key points:

2) Redwood retains VAT (EUR 7,680) in suspense; this is not waived.
3) Medivio will provide a VAT position note signed by a tax lead within 14 days of signing.
4) If tax determination indicates VAT is payable by Medivio, Redwood may issue a VAT-only invoice with 30-day payment terms.

DocuSign link: https://docusign.net/Medivio/Envelope/AB12CD34
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

Best,
Monica
